## Intro

Here we want to select 100 papers that did enrichment analysis.
We want to know:

* What tool was used for enrichment

* What prioritisation was reported

* From the data, what type of prioritisation was done

```{r,libs}

library("kableExtra")

```

## Read PubMedCentral Data

Search term: "pathway enrichment analysis" AND "RNA-seq"

Years: 2021-2025

Exclude embargoed

5,121 results obtained.

```{r,pmc_data}

x <- readLines("pubmed-pathwaye.txt")
pmid <- grep("PMID-",x)
issn <- grep("IS  - ",x)
combine <- c(pmid,issn)
combine <- combine[order(combine)]
pmid2issn <- x[combine]
pmid2issn <- gsub("-","",pmid2issn)

x2 <- lapply(grep("PMID",pmid2issn), function(i) {
  PMID <- pmid2issn[i]
  ISSN1 <- pmid2issn[grep(PMID,pmid2issn)+1]
  ISSN2 <- pmid2issn[grep(PMID,pmid2issn)+2]
  if ( ! grepl("IS",ISSN2) ) { ISSN2 <- NULL }
  ISSN1 <- gsub("IS   ","",ISSN1)
  ISSN2 <- gsub("IS   ","",ISSN2)
  PMID <- gsub("PMID ","",PMID)
  ISSN1 <- gsub("\ \\(Electronic\\)","",ISSN1)
  ISSN1 <- gsub("\ \\(Print\\)","",ISSN1)
  ISSN1 <- gsub("\ \\(Linking\\)","",ISSN1)
  ISSN2 <- gsub("\ \\(Electronic\\)","",ISSN2)
  ISSN2 <- gsub("\ \\(Print\\)","",ISSN2)
  ISSN2 <- gsub("\ \\(Linking\\)","",ISSN2)
  res <- c(PMID,ISSN1,ISSN2,"NA")
  return(res[1:3])
})
table(unlist(lapply(x2,length)))

x3 <-  do.call(rbind,x2)

colnames(x3) <- c("PMID","ISSN1","ISSN2")

```

## Read Scimago Journal Rank Data

This is the measure of journal prestige.

```{r,sjr}

sjr <- read.csv("scimagojr_2025.csv",sep=";")
sjr$ISSN1 <- sapply(strsplit(sjr$Issn,", "),"[[",1)
sjr$ISSN2 <- unlist(lapply(strsplit(sjr$Issn,", "),function(x) { x[length(x)] } ))

sjr2 <- sjr[which(sjr$SJR!=""),]
sjr2$SJR2 <- gsub(",",".",sjr2$SJR)
sjr2$SJR2 <- as.numeric(gsub(",",".",sjr2$SJR))

summary(sjr2$SJR2)

```

## Get SJR for each pubmed item

```{r,getsjr}

sjr_col <- unlist(lapply(1:nrow(x3), function(i) {
  issn1 <- x3[i,2]
  mysjr11 <- sjr2[which(sjr2$ISSN1==issn1),"SJR2"]
  mysjr12 <- sjr2[which(sjr2$ISSN1==issn2),"SJR2"]
  mysjr21 <- sjr2[which(sjr2$ISSN2==issn1),"SJR2"]
  mysjr22 <- sjr2[which(sjr2$ISSN2==issn2),"SJR2"]
  sjr_out <- sort(c(mysjr11,mysjr12,mysjr21,mysjr22),decreasing=TRUE)[1]
} ) )

str(sjr_col)
dim(x3)
x4 <- cbind(x3,sjr_col)
x4 <- as.data.frame(x4)
head(x4)

x4$sjr_col <- as.numeric(x4$sjr_col)
x4sort <- x4[order(-x4$sjr),]

head(x4sort)

```

## Output table

Here I output 200 papers.
Although we only need 100, we will need to remove some based on our selection criteria:

* Original research only, no reviews or opinion articles.

* Needs to show real data.

```{r,output_table}

top <- head(x4sort,200)

top |>
 kbl(caption="Top 200 pathway papers 2021-2025") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

write.table(x=top,file="toppapers.tsv",sep="\t",row.names=FALSE)

```
